rows.title: Realtime safety on the audio thread
rows.gaps: rtsan_check (RealtimeSanitizer, ADR-199) runs the real process() over all parameter ids, both engines, morph, intents, mod matrix, MIDI, loads, bypass and reactivation, with a planted fault and a clean control, in verify full; it is macOS-local and SKIPs without Homebrew LLVM, and CI does not run it. Paths outside its seeded schedule are unproven. For horde 2's engine: h2_rt_lint_check (verify fast) bans nine classes of allocating, locking, blocking or throwing construct under h2/, with the offline harness exempt and printed and four std::string uses in the frozen swarm core listed as waivers; h2_engine_rtsan_check (verify full, macOS-local like rtsan_check) runs RealtimeSanitizer over every engine call on the 543 parity scenarios, with a planted allocation. horde 2 has no shell to probe yet: waits on B398, whose acceptance rows are drafted in docs/proposals/h2-shell-acceptance.md.

rows.title: Thread races between UI, host and audio threads
rows.gaps: tsan_stress_check (ADR-200) drives the legacy shell's real entry points from a host-like main thread during render and holds ZERO main-thread write races over 3 seeds; load_handoff_check covers load ordering the sanitizer cannot see. Accepted until the legacy park trigger (ADR-186 section 6): read-only main-thread and host reads of audio-owned state, counted every run. Both run in verify full, macOS-local; tsan_stress_check SKIPs there without Homebrew LLVM (ADR-199). Since ADR-233 (B505) CI's sanitize (thread) leg runs tsan_stress_check on every PR with the runner's g++, its must-fire plants first and a SKIP failing the step; load_handoff_check still runs in verify full only. Paths outside the seeded schedule are unproven. horde 2 has no shell yet; ADR-200's shell rules make this harness its gate.

rows.title: NaN, Inf and denormals
rows.gaps: The legacy output guard now latches and counts (nan_latch_check; hostile_events_check reads the real plugin's counter), but the count reaches no user-visible surface yet. horde 2's engine has no output guard: it ends in tanh, and a NaN passes through. Flush-to-zero is ruled ON for the horde 2 shell from its first build (ADR-211; measured, 8 of 543 engine digests change, each sample by less than 4.1e-308), and since 2026-10-12 every gate that replays the engine runs it with the mode on, set in one shared switch (h2/flush_to_zero.h) inside the stream replay, with a must-fire line proving it per gate; the eight rows are re-pinned. No shell exists to set it for a host, the switch has never run on Windows, and it does not yet fix the rounding mode (ruled, ADR-213; in work). Legacy keeps snapping denormals in software in the swarm and sub cores. The parameter fuzz (h2_fuzz_check, verify full) counts non-finite samples over the engine's ranged keys: none in 12,000 measured cases. The horde 2 shell's latch-and-report guard and its user-visible count are ruled (ADR-209 item 7) and wait on B398.
rows.tripwire: NaN events: 0, plus the guard's trip count

rows.title: Sample-rate and block-size dependence
rows.gaps: Rate and block-size checks exist per mechanism. No full matrix rendering each reference patch at 44.1/48/96/192 kHz and blocks of 1, 7, 64, 512 and varying, compared on perceptual features.

rows.title: Long-run drift
rows.gaps: stability_check holds RMS drift, f0 drift, peak and non-finite count over 60 simulated seconds of the legacy SAW core in verify full (the ten-minute run is by hand). No 4-hour nightly soak per engine with level, DC and spectral-centroid bounds.

rows.title: Numerical stability at the edges
rows.gaps: Legacy: note-stream fuzzing, hostile-event checks and a high-coupling lifecycle probe. horde 2's engine: h2_fuzz_check (verify full; a deep run in the nightly job list) draws seeded cases over the 112 keys the declared table gives a range, with sweeps and stacked changes, and judges every sample for non-finite values, growth, and silence after release; planted faults (blow-up, slow growth, plateau, burst, NaN, hang, misread) must be found on every run. Not yet: 21 engine keys have no declared range and are never fuzzed (printed as a hole on every run); the level bands are a runaway alarm and would pass an engine twice as loud on every patch, so level regression waits on the per-patch measurements (phase 2 package P9); growth that only appears during a sweep is not followed; the thresholds are proposed, not ratified; the nightly workflow is not installed, so the deep run has never run.

rows.title: State and preset compatibility
rows.gaps: Three state fixtures load bit-identically; load_handoff_check holds that a load is whole whether or not the plugin is processing (ADR-200, ADR-208); and param_id_lock_check locks all 397 host-visible parameter ids append-only (removal, renumbering, re-ranging and reuse are red; its full row asks the real plugin). Defaults are deliberately not locked: a default change is caught only by the ADR-and-migration rule in review. No per-release saved-state corpus rendered in CI (nothing is released yet). horde 2 has no parameter manifest, so its lock section is a stub (B308 H4).

rows.title: Host integration edge cases
rows.gaps: pluginval runs at strictness 10 in CI (Windows on every PR, macOS on main pushes). auval is a manual step, not a gate. No clap-validator, scripted host matrix, or two-instance shared-state test.
rows.tripwire: Validators: all green, N hosts tested

rows.title: Perceptual quality not heard on monitors
rows.gaps: A fitted aliasing metric across the keyboard. No per-patch suite for true peak, DC, sub-20 Hz energy or mono-sum loss with stored thresholds.
rows.tripwire: A spectrum report per engine, red flags only

rows.title: The parity-golden trap
rows.gaps: Parity with the prototypes is provisional under ADR-187. Few closed-form, conservation or metamorphic tests independent of the prototypes, and golden_registry_check now counts them: 1 of 39 goldens carries an independent check, and none is closed-form.
rows.tripwire: Goldens with independent check: N of M

rows.title: Build and platform divergence
rows.gaps: build_flags_check pins the numerics and safety flags of all 108 build targets, and any fast-math-family flag anywhere is red. Pinning found gaps, tracked on B454: the legacy plugin is optimised only when configured as Release, only the native architecture is built on macOS, the build sets no warnings, MSVC gets no floating-point flags from the repo, and the sanitizer loop skips 12 executables. x86_64 is exercised only by CI's Linux sanitizer job and the Windows build and validation; no parity run on x86_64 at the shipped Release flags. ADR-209 item 8: the two architectures are macOS arm64 and Windows x64; Intel macOS is not a 1.0 platform.

rows.title: Worst-case CPU and licensing exposure
rows.gaps: license_audit_check holds 11 third-party components (8 ship) against an allow list ratified 2026-10-10 (ADR-205), each license read from the component's own files at its pin. Two exceptions are accepted with expiries (ADR-204, ADR-206); none is pending. The SBOM generator omits three nested shipping components. Ten release questions are open in docs/LICENSES-THIRD-PARTY.md. The B439 budget and the CPU ledger exist as documents, and the CPU measurement is run by hand; no per-release gate on the worst-case patch.
rows.tripwire: Worst-case CPU: X% of budget; Licenses: clear

rows.title: Symptom clamping
rows.gaps: weakening_check counts isfinite, isnan and std::clamp in src/ and h2/ and is red on any increase the human has not approved. Since 2026-10-12 that approval must cite a trace with a root-cause section that names the file, and the rule is re-checked on every run; a guard tagged as boundary validation or a latching output guard still needs the approval but no trace (ADR-213). Not yet: min/max nests, ternary and if-assign clamps, tanh-style limits and home-made clamp helpers are unseen until the human approves a one-time re-baseline of 75 lines under h2/; a change that tags an old guard and adds a new untagged one reads the same as an honest new tagged guard, so the approval prints every guard line and the human must read them; a ledger edited by hand skips the approval path
rows.tripwire: New DSP clamps without a root-cause trace: 0

rows.title: Snapshot of the bug
rows.gaps: golden_registry_check (verify fast) discovers every golden and pin by rule and is red for one with no registry entry, for an entry citing a check verify does not run, and for an independence claim with no evidence. Not yet: an entry may still be registered as prototype-parity-only, and 38 of the 39 are, so nothing forces a NEW golden to carry an independent justification; whether bit-identity pins count as goldens is the lead's reading, not yet ruled
rows.tripwire: New goldens without a named justification: 0

rows.title: Tolerance creep
rows.gaps: tolerance_registry_check pins 138 tolerances (ACCEPTANCE.md and the C++ checks) and fails on any unapproved change or unregistered newcomer. Not yet: the JS labs and oracles (.mjs), integer thresholds written inline, tolerances computed from other names; 75 entries have no governing ADR yet; it cannot prove an `approved` reference came from the human.

rows.title: Quiet disabling
rows.gaps: test_table_check makes every check declare whether ./verify runs it, and cross-checks the claim. weakening_check counts skips, suppressions, disabled sanitizers, soft-fails, UNWIRED declarations and DSP guards against a baseline and fails on any increase. Every golden-parity gate now fails below a pinned scenario count, so a corpus cannot shrink quietly (parity_floor_check and in-source floors, thirteen gates; found by the 2026-10-10 audit). Not yet: markers assembled by macro, and proof that an `approved` reference was written by the human rather than an agent.
rows.tripwire: Skips, suppressions and disabled sanitizers: no increase

rows.title: Happy-path tests
rows.gaps: engine_enrolment_check (verify fast) is red for any code directory under h2/ with no entry in docs/armor/engines.json, and the harness selftest (verify full) proves each enrolled adapter makes sound, with a silent adapter failing. Not yet: the extreme-parameter fuzz and the sweep matrix that run over every enrolled engine (phase 2 packages P3 and P4), so enrolment does not yet imply those cases
